sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which technique is commonly used to create beautiful circular resistance patterns on fabric using threads and fabric dyes?
Fill in the blank: A __________ is a specifically prepared soil bed or container where seeds are sown to germinate into seedlings before transplanting.
Which of the following is a primary benefit of establishing a habitat garden in the school premises?
options: B) Attracting local biodiversity like butterflies and birds
C) Providing a space for heavy machinery
D) Reducing the water supply of the school
questions.answer: B) Attracting local biodiversity like butterflies and birds

questions.question_text: What is the specific purpose of using a chemical mordant like salt or alum during the tie and dye process?
options: A) To wash the fabric quickly
B) To make the fabric completely waterproof
C) To help the dye fix permanently to the fabric
D) To tie the threads tightly
questions.answer: C) To help the dye fix permanently to the fabric

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: __________ is the agricultural process of loosening and turning the soil to increase aeration and water absorption for growing nursery plants.

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the primary vocational objective of setting up a commercial 'Plant Nursery'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A plant nursery focuses on breeding, growing, and maintaining young saplings and ornamental plants until they are mature enough to be sold for home gardens or large landscaping projects.

questions.question_text: Describe two essential elements required to successfully build a wildlife-friendly school habitat garden. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A successful habitat garden requires native plant species that provide nectar and seeds, along with a small, clean water source like a birdbath to sustain visiting birds and insects.

questions.question_text: Explain why it is important to wash the tied fabric in cold water after the dyeing process is complete. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Washing the newly dyed fabric in cold water effectively removes any excess, unattached dye and prevents the vibrant colors from bleeding or fading prematurely.

questions.question_text: Suppose your class is tasked with designing a small medicinal plant nursery within the school habitat garden. Outline the step-by-step procedure you would follow to prepare the site and plant the saplings. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, select a well-lit area and clear it of weeds. Next, till the soil and mix in organic compost for nutrients. Finally, carefully dig small pits, place the medicinal saplings like aloe vera or tulsi, and water them gently.
